BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating an inschool holiday in honor of RosaParks; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.230 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.230RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) On December 1st of each year or the preceding Friday whenDecember 1st falls on a nonschool day, "Rosa Parks day" shall beobserved within each public school. (2) Annually the state superintendent of public instruction shallprepare and publish for circulation among public schools a suggestedcurriculum for use on Rosa Parks day embodying topics pertinent to thecivil rights movement of the United States and to Ms. Parks's role inand influence upon the civil rights movement. (3) The presentation and activities required by this section shallencompass the entire school day of not less then five hours. (4) The principal or head teacher of the school building has theresponsibility for ensuring the preparation and presentation of the p. 1 HB 3284instruction and activities required by this section.
